newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IRA claims credit for UK rail attack.
newsitem.headline: IRA claims credit for UK rail attack.

text.p: IRA guerrillas fighting British rule of Northern Ireland on Friday claimed responsibility for a bomb attack on a British rail network on Wednesday.
The claim was made in a call to Ireland's semi-state RTE radio network.
Bombs placed on the track near Wilmslow, in Cheshire, severely disrupted traffic and grabbed headlines in the runup to British elections on May 1.
A caller using a recognised codeword warned police about the bombs. No injuries were reported.

The Irish Republican Army has fought British rule of Northern Ireland for 28 years. It is demanding entry into Belfast peace talks but Britain says it cannot take part until it ends violence altogether.
